findings: Episode count advanced from 66 to 75 while investigating; episode files and PPO rollout metrics continue updating.
Unity is CPU busy; Python uses very little CPU, so this is not a PPO optimization stall.
Every measured action advances navigation; the implementation reconstructs the observed-grid planner and runs reachable-frontier search even with an existing goal/waypoint.
A-star route search uses a linear scan of its open list; escape/frontier handoffs create additional route searches.
Progress JSON is written only after an episode ends; the count can stay unchanged while hundreds of actions are executing.
limits: No per-method Unity profiler timings were collected; navigation, sensing and physics costs have not been individually apportioned.
Remaining-time estimate assumes current observed pace; it is not a completion guarantee.
